campaign.campaignDescription: Acme Coffee Co. sends weekly promotional offers and new-product announcements to customers who opt in at checkout or on our website. Messages link to acme.example.com and always include opt-out instructions.
sampleMessages: Acme Coffee: 20% off all beans this week. Shop acme.example.com/sale. Msg&data rates may apply. Reply STOP to opt out, HELP for help.
Acme Coffee: New single-origin just dropped. Browse acme.example.com/new. Reply STOP to unsubscribe.
campaign.messageFlow: Customers opt in by checking an unchecked SMS-consent box at checkout on acme.example.com or by texting START to our number. Consent is not a condition of purchase.
campaign.optInMessage: Acme Coffee: You're subscribed to weekly offers. Reply STOP to opt out, HELP for help. Msg&data rates may apply.
campaign.optOutMessage: Acme Coffee: You're unsubscribed and won't receive more messages. Reply START to rejoin.
campaign.helpMessage: Acme Coffee: For help, email support@acme.example.com. Reply STOP to opt out.
